The introduction of `CompositeSyntheticFieldLoader.MalformedValuesLayer` and its usage in various classes requires careful handling to ensure that malformed values are correctly written. Verify that all implementations of `writeValue` properly handle the writing of malformed values.

The changes in the `storedFieldLoaders` method across various classes now rely on the `StoredFieldLoader` interface. Ensure that all implementations of `StoredFieldLoader` properly load values from stored fields.

The changes in the `hasValue` method across various classes now rely on the `storedFieldLoadersHaveValues`, `docValuesLoadersHaveValues`, and `ignoredValuesPresent` flags. Ensure that these flags are correctly updated to reflect whether there are values to be written.

The introduction of the `CompositeSyntheticFieldLoaderTests` class provides test coverage for the new functionality. Ensure that all critical logic paths are covered by these tests and that boundary conditions are tested.

The changes in the `docValuesLoader` method across various classes now rely on the `DocValuesLoader` interface. Ensure that all implementations of `DocValuesLoader` properly load values from doc values.

The introduction of `CompositeSyntheticFieldLoader.StoredFieldLayer` and its usage in various classes requires careful handling to ensure that the `advanceToDoc` method is correctly implemented. Verify that all implementations of `StoredFieldLoader` properly reset their state when `advanceToDoc` is called.

The removal of the `simpleName` parameter and its usage in various classes can lead to confusion since `leafFieldName` is now used instead. Ensure that all usages of `simpleName` have been correctly replaced with `leafFieldName` to maintain consistency and avoid potential bugs.

review_comment: Should this be moved to the loop below, right before calling `load`? I wonder if we end up advancing loaders that are not needed..

The loop below is executed only if there are values for the field in the current document, so if we do this there we have the same problem with stale values. We actually _want_ to advance all loaders.
Yes, it is possible that the field is both stored and has doc values. Composite loader merges data from all layers so that would not be correct.
